"""Stable behavior checks that remain meaningful across patch-version bumps."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from calculator import add


@pytest.mark.parametrize(("left", "right", "expected"), [(1, 2, 3), (-4, 5, 1), (0, 0, 0)])
def test_add(left: int, right: int, expected: int) -> None:
    assert add(left, right) == expected


def test_cli_addition() -> None:
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "calculator.py", "2", "3"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
    )
    assert result.stdout == "5\n"


def test_cli_reports_canonical_release() -> None:
    expected = Path("VERSION").read_text().strip()
    assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+", expected)
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "calculator.py", "--version"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
    )
    assert result.stdout == expected + "\n"
